occasion_label: Single assessment conducted over two sessions
notes: Reference analytic N=973 in the author-selected Study 2 dataset (PDF pp.10-11; public original-item data verified against the source manifest). Private-comment exclusions cannot be independently reconstructed. 23 released records have the entire HEXACO block missing. Pearson correlations use available pairs; pair N ranges 790-973. Reference N remains 973; no participants are removed for missing age or the binary sex/gender contrast. Male=0 and female=1; other categories/nonresponse are missing only for that contrast. Age range 18-49 is coded adult under the mixed-adult convention. The two sessions measured different constructs rather than repeated SEB waves. BESSI-96 form type retains the historical long classification. Distinct persuasion/perspective scoring was confirmed by the user on 2026-11-04; domain weights are normalised to retain the 1-5 metric. Observed task components and questionnaire means are retained separately from latent factors. The pairwise matrix has a small negative minimum eigenvalue (-4.1337e-05); observed correlations were not repaired. Extraction audits are under extraction/0145; current analytical integration status is recorded separately in integration/batches.csv and integration/matrices.csv.
